architecture.backend: app/api/demo_routes.py (data-overview, sample-alert, review-queue) -- demo-only, NOT part of the master plan section 13 production API contract
architecture.frontend: app/static/{demo.html,demo.css,demo.js} -- vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, no build tool, no external CDN dependency, served directly by FastAPI's StaticFiles
architecture.data_flow: UI -> /api/v1/demo/sample-alert (demo-only, returns real PII) -> /api/v1/alerts/score (REAL production endpoint, same path a real integration would use)

critical_security_note: app/api/demo_routes.py and app/services/demo_data.py return REAL customer PII (names, DOB, nationality) over HTTP by design -- that is what makes the demo useful. These routes MUST be removed or gated behind network/auth controls before any deployment outside a local/controlled demo environment. They are intentionally kept in separate modules from the production scoring API (app/services/scoring.py, app/api/routes.py) specifically so this removal is a clean, obvious cut, not a refactor. This module's own docstring states the same warning.

verified.no_pii_in_any_committed_file: demo.html/css/js contain no data, only UI code; app/services/demo_data.py and app/api/demo_routes.py contain no hardcoded examples, only logic that reads gitignored local data at request time

next_gate: Phase 10 -- Feedback, monitoring, and model registry foundations (drift monitors, retraining triggers, feedback validation pipeline). Requires human approval.
